task.title: To highlight smart and read-only fields

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the X-Author for Contracts Advanced add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
In the Contracts pane, go to Work > Highlight Fields. If you do not see Highlight Fields under the Work tab, click the More button () and from the menu, select Highlight Fields.

postreq.p: Smart fields are highlighted in green and read-only fields are highlighted in yellow. Field highlighting is not retained when you check the document in, send the document for review, or close Microsoft Word.
